title: Power Platform governance: multi-grader comparison for agent evaluations
summary: Pass with a descriptive gap: the roadmap promises supporting evidence, but does not say the new comparison displays agent responses. The signed-in-user statement should be narrowed to the preview experience; the cited standard-harness API also supports unauthenticated runs. Embedded historical correction directions were ignored as instructions.

claims.claim: Existing run comparisons are reached in Copilot Studio at agent > Evaluation > Recent test results > test run > Compare with > comparison run.
claims.quote:
In your agent's Evaluation page, under Recent test results, open the test run you want to use as the base for the comparison.
Select the Compare with dropdown, and then select the time and date of the test run you want to compare with the currently open test results.

claims.claim: The Power Platform API runs an existing evaluation test set with POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testsets/{TestSetId}/run?api-version=2024-10-01.
claims.quote:
Endpoint: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testsets/{TestSetId}/run?api-version=2024-10-01
Purpose: Run an evaluation for a test set by using the test set's id.

claims.claim: GET .../testruns/{TestRunId} retrieves existing evaluation results.
claims.quote:
GET https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/environments/{EnvironmentId}/bots/{BotId}/api/makerevaluation/testruns/{TestRunId}?api-version=2024-10-01
Purpose: Retrieve the details of an evaluation by using the runId for your target evaluation run.

claims.claim: No tenant admin UI switch or API switch for multi-grader comparison is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "multi-grader comparison" enable tenant Power Platform API Dataverse. Opened analytics-agent-evaluation-results, analytics-agent-evaluation-rest-api and admin-data-loss-prevention; no UI or automation switch for this named comparison was stated.

claims.claim: Existing evaluation is a maker feature.
claims.quote: An evaluation test set can be run multiple times by several "makers" of the same agent. Makers can run evaluations using test sets created by other makers.

claims.claim: In the existing experience, Evaluate is a separate action selected at the end of creating or editing a test set.
claims.quote: At the end of creating or editing a test set, select Evaluate.

claims.where: Governance controls: connector data policy paragraph
claims.claim: Blocking the Microsoft Copilot Studio connection prevents existing authenticated evaluation tests.
claims.quote: Agent evaluations that use user authentication require access through the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector. If your admin turns off this connection, you can't run tests by using the evaluation tool.

claims.where: Governance controls: connector data policy paragraph
claims.claim: Data policies are located in the Power Platform admin center under Security > Data and privacy > Data policy.
claims.quote:
On the sidebar, select Security, and then select Data and privacy. The Data protection and privacy page opens.
Select Data policy. The Data policies list appears.

claims.claim: Existing evaluation access can be managed through agent sharing and the agent viewer role.
claims.quote: If you're the agent owner and want to grant access only to the Evaluation page of your agent, share the agent and enable the agent viewer sharing role. Users with this role can manage evaluations for a specific agent without access to the agent itself.

claims.claim: Existing evaluations run with the currently signed-in user profile.
claims.quote: Evaluations and connections used by tools run with the currently signed-in user profile.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with 'In the preview new agent experience, evaluations and connections used by tools run with the currently signed-in user profile.' The cited standard-harness API page https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/analytics-agent-evaluation-rest-api says: 'If you don't add an mcsConnectionId to your call, the evaluation runs without authentication.'

claims.claim: The linked evaluation methods page lists available graders for existing evaluations.
claims.quote: When you create test sets, choose from different test methods to evaluate your agent's responses. Each test method has its own strengths and suits different types of evaluations.
